subject: reasoning
question:
What would be the symbol on the opposite side of '*' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2dcd39c94f48826ae97b149c65fc290c32bd58cac09903dab37dfea18d7e006.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56cd90b8eec9d11c26c0efb3d5127aa04367e941f4a932d49ee10c38cfb4ef7d.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

@ → $

¥ → #

* → %

Therefore, '%' is the opposite of '*'.

Hence,** "Option - (3)"** is the correct answer.
